LEADERSHIP CHANGE - IMPORTANT: the earlier seed recorded Dave Goffeney as Lead Pastor, but as of 2026-09-10 he is no longer on the team page. The team page now reads 'Marcus Doe - Elder and Interim Lead Pastor', alongside lay elders Paul Bell, Joel Harris (also Worship Director) and Joel Johnson. Goffeney is kept with active:false because he preached most of the 1 Corinthians series through June 2026; the site gives no statement about why or exactly when he left, so do not characterise the departure. The published 1 Corinthians series page credits each sermon: Goffeney preached most Sundays from January to mid-June 2026, and Marcus Doe preached every listed Sunday from 21 June through 6 September 2026. Joel Johnson preached once (7 June 2026, 1 Cor 7:17-24); he is not recorded as a pastor because one sermon is not a regular pulpit rotation - revisit if he appears more often. The 'Acts 29-style' label in the previous denomination string was removed: the network doctrine page (network.redemptionaz.com/doctrine) states no denominational or network affiliation. Sermons are easy to assemble - YouTube (@redemptionchurchtucson4388), Apple and Spotify podcast feeds, plus per-series pages on the site that name the preacher, which makes per-pastor attribution straightforward.
